abortion.summary: As the incumbent, she cosponsored House Bill 26 of the 2025-2026 session, the Reproductive Freedom Act, which would repeal existing abortion restrictions and provide for reproductive rights.
abortion.short: Cosponsored 2025 Reproductive Freedom Act repealing abortion restrictions.

healthcare.summary: She cosponsored House Bill 79 of the 2025-2026 session, which would establish a Pennsylvania Medical Debt Relief Program and hospital-based financial assistance requirements.
healthcare.short: Cosponsored 2025 bill creating a medical debt relief program.

guns.summary: In April 2026 she announced state grants for after-school, summer, and violence-prevention programs in the Bristol area, describing them as a strategy to keep young people in safe environments and strengthen community safety.
guns.short: Announced grants for youth and violence-prevention programs as community safety.

taxes.summary: Her Bucks County Beacon candidate profile lists property tax reform among her priorities.
taxes.short: Lists property tax reform among her priorities.

education.summary: Her Bucks County Beacon candidate profile lists sustainable funding for public education among her priorities.
education.short: Lists sustainable funding for public education among priorities.

economy.summary: Her Bucks County Beacon candidate profile lists economic development through job creation and pay equity among her priorities.
economy.short: Lists job creation and pay equity among priorities.

taxes.summary: His campaign site says he prioritizes fiscal responsibility and lowering property taxes, stating that government should never spend more than it takes.
taxes.short: Prioritizes fiscal responsibility and lowering property taxes.

guns.summary: His campaign lists community safety as one of his priorities; the site does not detail a specific public-safety position.
guns.short: Lists community safety as a priority; no detail given.
